01-holzinger-swineford.script:
# Forma analysis; lavaan 0.7.3
# R version 4.4.3 (2025-02-28 ucrt)
# Place the original source file in the working directory.
library(lavaan)

data <- lavaan::HolzingerSwineford1939


fit <- cfa(
  model = "visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3\ntextual =~ x4 + x5 + x6\nspeed =~ x7 + x8 + x9",
  data = data,
  estimator = "ML",
  missing = "listwise",
  fixed.x = FALSE,
  meanstructure = FALSE
)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, level = 0.95, boot.ci.type = "perc")

03-mediation.script:
# Forma analysis; lavaan 0.7.3
# R version 4.4.3 (2025-02-28 ucrt)
# Place the original source file in the working directory.
library(lavaan)

i <- seq_len(400)
X <- sin(i*.37) + cos(i*.11)
M <- .6*X + sin(i*.71) + .4*cos(i*.17)
Y <- .45*M + .2*X + cos(i*.53) + .2*sin(i*.29)
data <- data.frame(X, M, Y)


fit <- sem(
  model = "M ~ a*X\nY ~ b*M + cp*X\nind := a*b\ntotal := cp + ind",
  data = data,
  estimator = "ML",
  missing = "listwise",
  fixed.x = FALSE,
  meanstructure = FALSE
)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, level = 0.95, boot.ci.type = "perc")

ordinal.script:
# Forma analysis; lavaan 0.7.3
# R version 4.4.3 (2025-02-28 ucrt)
# Place the original source file in the working directory.
library(lavaan)

data <- read.table("ordinal.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", quote = '"', na.strings = c("", "NA"), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = '', fileEncoding = 'UTF-8-BOM', fill = FALSE)
data[["x1"]] <- ordered(data[["x1"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
data[["x2"]] <- ordered(data[["x2"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
data[["x3"]] <- ordered(data[["x3"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
data[["x4"]] <- ordered(data[["x4"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
data[["x5"]] <- ordered(data[["x5"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
data[["x6"]] <- ordered(data[["x6"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
data[["x7"]] <- ordered(data[["x7"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
data[["x8"]] <- ordered(data[["x8"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))
data[["x9"]] <- ordered(data[["x9"]], levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))

fit <- cfa(
  model = "visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3\ntextual =~ x4 + x5 + x6\nspeed =~ x7 + x8 + x9",
  data = data,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "listwise",
  fixed.x = FALSE,
  meanstructure = FALSE,
  ordered = c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x8", "x9")
)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, level = 0.95, boot.ci.type = "perc")
